record.title: China’s agriculture ministry opens a key-lab selection round for agricultural AI and biomanufacturing
record.summary: China’s Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs published a call on 6 November 2026, signed by its Science and Technology Department on 5 November, to add key laboratories in agricultural AI and biomanufacturing. The notice gives applicant, staffing and facility criteria and sets a 30 November submission deadline. The linked directions and application forms were not readable in this review. This is evidence of a ministry selection process, not of awarded funding, selected laboratories, operating labs or research outcomes.
organizations: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs of China

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED
claims.text: On 6 November 2026, China’s Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs published a call to select an additional batch of key laboratories in agricultural AI and biomanufacturing.

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED
claims.text: The notice sets applicant, staffing and facility eligibility conditions and a 30 November 2026 deadline for submissions.

evidence_gaps.description: The official attachment with the specific research directions, application form and recommendation-list template could not be read through the linked DOCX reader.
No selected laboratory, award allocation, operating status or research result is available before the application deadline.

brief.importance_rationale: If carried through, a national ministry’s selection of new key laboratories in agricultural AI and biomanufacturing could shape sector research capacity and institutional priorities. The notice provides no funding amount, award list or realized outcomes, so the consequence is meaningful but bounded.
limitations: The selection call does not establish that any laboratory has been selected, funded or opened.
No funding amount, awarded institution, operational capability or research outcome is stated on the accessible notice page.
The linked DOCX containing field directions and application forms was inaccessible through the official reader during this activation.
organizations: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs of China

relationships.summary: The earlier national agricultural plan states broad agricultural-AI directions; this later ministry notice opens a specific laboratory selection round but does not show that the plan’s goals have been funded or implemented.

technical.claimed_result: The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs states that it is adding a batch of key laboratories in agricultural AI and biomanufacturing through this selection round.
technical.demonstrated_result: The accessible official notice establishes the application process, two fields, applicant criteria and a 30 November 2026 deadline. It does not establish selection, funding, operation or research output.
technical.implementation_status: Application and recommendation process announced; selections and awards not yet reported.
technical.mechanism: The ministry invites eligible research institutions, universities and firms to apply for an additional batch of key laboratories in agricultural AI and biomanufacturing; provincial departments and designated central organizations review and recommend applications.
technical.regime: China’s Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs key-laboratory program; applications due by 30 November 2026. The notice page is accessible, while its linked DOCX directions and forms were not readable here.
technical.reproducibility: Not applicable to a policy notice; independently inspect the linked directions and later award records.
technical.strongest_baseline: The source describes a new additional selection round; it gives no baseline count of existing laboratories, prior funding or current operating capacity.

other.title: China’s 2026–2030 agriculture plan sets policy directions for AI, datasets and compute
other.summary: China’s State Council 2026–2030 agricultural and rural modernization plan directs faster agricultural AI innovation and application, expansion of application scenarios, agricultural/rural data infrastructure and large, multimodal, high-quality datasets with data standards. It also calls for domestic-software and hardware development, improved computing capacity and an integrated sky–air–ground agricultural observation network. The Ministry of Agriculture’s page is dated 2026-09-07 and says the online text is abridged; the notice itself states that the State Council issued the plan on 2026-05-26. These are central policy directions, not funded commitments, local deployments or measured effects.
organizations: State Council of the People’s Republic of China
Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs
